header: The three people on a typical project
subheadline: Every project has one designer, one researcher and one systems engineer, from the first interview to handover. The person who drew a screen is the one who explains it.

members.name: Clara Nunes
members.bio: Led the Kestrel Bank onboarding rebuild, which cut drop-off from 38 per cent to 17. She joined in 2019 from a newsroom design team.

members.name: Inês Duarte
members.bio: Runs the field studies. She spent six weeks in Northwind depots before anyone at the studio started designing.

members.name: Rafael Lima
members.bio: Maintains the four component libraries we give to client engineering teams. He also writes the handover notes.
